title: Corrected conditional Graph Lite v2: independently authored fresh corpus, native Codex r2
ownerAuthorization: User requested full Graph Lite implementation, semantic scoring fixes and fresh Codex-only measurement without Claude CLI, continued implementation, and approved actual gpt-6.1-sol mandatory gpt-5.6-terra compatibility. This corrected read-only32-arm experiment is necessary after independent review found engine defects; no production actions or global auto-activation.
cohort: 8 newly independently authored synthetic Python repositories;8 demonstrated hidden contract behaviors across6 seeded tasks and2 independently refuted clean controls. Five graph-eligible tasks including one clean control;3single-route tasks. Prior studies and efficacy corpus excluded. No production-representativeness claim.

arms.G: Complete conditional policy: three-agent contract/integration/checker graph where exact owner policy qualifies; identical single-agent path otherwise. Deterministic synthesis, no LLM synth.
arms.K: One fresh contract-and-integration reviewer; same task/contracts/function inventory and tool access. No graph or peer outputs.

contexts: Every measured agent fork_turns=none with explicit model=gpt-6.1-sol and reasoning_effort=high in the bound native spawn arguments, one native session per node. Arms sequential, at most two hunters parallel with barrier before checker. No unrelated operator work during active arm.
timing: time.monotonic_ns on WSL for t0 before policy/task preparation and t1 immediately after final serialization (single) or graph record (graph). Pin /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; a reboot/negative elapsed makes study invalid. Clone/config/standing owner authorization preparation excluded equally; routing and graph record included. Native wall timestamps retained for provenance only.

decision.unit: unique hidden defect, average two pairs; clean tasks included in cost/precision and routing counts
decision.operationalCompleteness: Every policy arm must produce valid structured output/graph receipt for WIN; model work failures count zero catch and are not rerun.

semantic: No file/line/category auto-credit. Every proposed seed match receives blind semantic adjudication; every finding receives independent realness judgment. Local stated-contract violations evaluated separately from operational reachability. One-to-one maximum matching; exact rational calculations. Native evaluator answers copied unchanged; no operator answers.
blinding: Opaque input-bound IDs; common semantic observation schema. Narrative attribution may be explicitly redacted; semantic input, expected/actual outcomes and evidence are never rewritten. Each judge executes exactly one literal assigned-capsule read, then zero further tools. Realness capsules include SHA-bound public source text; semantic capsules contain only supplied observations/behaviors. Native tool audit rejects every other or repeated call.
isolation: Every measured node reads exactly one literal assigned task capsule and then uses zero further tools. Capsules include identical SHA-bound full tracked public base source text for both arms, task/schema and permitted upstream proposals only. No inline execution, source/Git mutations, package/app/test runs, network, Claude CLI, skills, delegation, siblings, bases, sealed inputs or native logs. Exact native-call audit rejects dynamic/relative/additional reads; literal sealed-input access permanently invalidates study. Host is trusted to deliver the literal bound read; no OS-sandbox claim. Close completed clones chmod000. Any unapproved tool call permanently invalidates the study because hidden-data exposure cannot be excluded. No tool call or invalid answer without extra I/O is a model work failure, not an infrastructure retry.
preExposure: Operator saw previous study/auxiliary efficacy and independent review plus this public catalog, but not this new hidden manifest or private fixture-refutation findings. Fixture author and checker had fresh contexts and no previous corpus access. Every measured actor is fresh and receives only frozen task metadata and its clone. No tuning after measured answers.

stopRule.modelWorkFailure: Keep failed native output and audit; findings empty, charge full elapsed; no retry or repair of the answer. No operational WIN if a policy arm fails.
stopRule.infrastructure: Void whole current pair only for genuine tool/environment failure, settle/audit every dispatched child, retain immutable negative evidence. One fresh-clone retry per pair, at most2voided pairs; any second retry failure invalidates full study.
stopRule.sealed: Any measured actor reading sealed inputs invalidates study permanently. Hash-only machine integrity checks of sealed bytes permitted; no model reads/semantic scoring before32valid attempts.
stopRule.noPeeking: Freeze code/protocol, collect all32 attempts, revalidate, then open hidden manifest and blind queue. No intermediate scoring, no reruns to improve outcome.
stopRule.nativeLifecycle: Only task_complete may supply an accepted measured or grader answer. turn_aborted/cancelled is recognized as settled only for typed infrastructure handling; any emitted final before abort is not accepted. Unapproved grader I/O is durably snapshotted with violation audit and permanently invalidates study; future grading refuses the saved violation marker independently of mutable state.

sourceAuthority: Native tool transport and policy delivery rely on honest host, not provider signatures. Parent encrypted task text is retained/bound by dispatch identity plus immutable task SHA; plaintext delivery is an explicit host assertion.
implementationDisposition: Explicit project opt-in can run the bounded experimental policy; no global mandatory rollout from this controlled study. WIN supports a separate adoption decision; LOSE is reported without changing thresholds or old data.
gradingRetry: Only the supported retry command may advance one settled, provenance-valid, isolation-valid malformed answer map to one fresh native session. Preserve rejected snapshot/dispatch proof and bind the updated attempt hash. Valid judgments, accepted results, model/provider changes and a second retry are forbidden. A partial write or isolation refusal remains fail-closed; preserve evidence and recover explicitly before any further launch.
historicalDisposition: Original r1 data remains unchanged, replayed only with sourceTree a3a4d6b53780bfa5ed7437744c81d88fede25a4b. It does not qualify corrected sources. New raw arms, judges, timestamps and verdicts are not copied from any prior study.
sourceFreeze: Pin every measured source, context helper, grader, result verifier, protocol, public catalog and hidden manifest before the first arm. Snapshot bytes before native dispatch. Current-source replay requires equality with every frozen file, without scorer exceptions.

gradingCapsules.partition: Deterministic greedy packing, sources deduplicated by original public base path, source text and hash bound to premeasurement inventory. Reject any single question exceeding the cap.
